# TechCrunch

> > TechCrunch is the leading technology media property covering startups, venture capital, AI innovation, and emerging tech trends through news, analysis, and flagship events like TechCrunch Disrupt and Startup Battlefield.

TechCrunch provides comprehensive coverage of the technology industry with a focus on startup culture, venture capital funding, product launches, and breakthrough innovations. The site features video content including TechCrunch Minute segments, founder interviews, pitch competitions, and panel discussions from major tech events like Disrupt and CES.

## Key Topics

- TechCrunch Disrupt
- Startup Battlefield
- Venture Capital
- OpenAI & GPT-4o
- Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- CES 2025
- Crypto & Tokenization
- TechCrunch Minute
- Cybersecurity
- Climate Tech
- Autonomous Vehicles
- Fintech
- SaaS Startups
- StrictlyVC
- Pitch Competitions

## AI & Machine Learning

- [TechCrunch Minute: OpenAI's latest GPT-4o model gets weird](https://techcrunch.com/video/techcrunch-minute-openais-latest-gpt4-o-model-gets-weird): OpenAI's GPT-4o model exhibits unusual behaviors including voice mimicking
- [Watch: LinkedIn wants AI to help you find a job](https://techcrunch.com/video/techcrunch-minute-linkedin-offers-ai-written-cover-letters): LinkedIn adds AI features for cover letters and career coaching
- [Watch: AI could help design and test F1 cars faster](https://techcrunch.com/video/techcrunch-minute-ai-could-help-design-and-test-f1-cars-faster): BeyondMath uses AI simulation to accelerate Formula One car design
- [Watch: Should facial recognition technology be used in schools?](https://techcrunch.com/video/techcrunch-minute-a-uk-school-was-reprimanded-for-unlawful-use-of-facial-recognition-technology): UK school reprimanded for using facial recognition without consent
